$Comment: What the red Christmas Packet at the back of the Yeti's den holds, rolled fresh into it each time a party's cave is pasted (tools/arenas/Christmas_Yeti_Cave.json names it on the packet): a bundle of snowballs every time, then each Choice below on its own when its Weight, its chance out of 100, comes up: a Christmas Present the Yeti took from Santa's sleigh, and a little Ice Essence. It holds no Yeti Bait on purpose: the packet refills every run, so bait here would make the way in pay for itself.
